{"query":"
  query GetVaultsByDepositorFirstPage($depositor: String!, $limit: Int!) {
    vaults(where: { depositor: $depositor }, limit: $limit) {
      items {
        
  id
  depositor
  depositorBtcPubKey
  vaultProvider
  amount
  applicationEntryPoint
  status
  inUse
  ackCount
  depositorSignedPeginTx
  unsignedPrePeginTx
  peginTxHash
  hashlock
  htlcVout
  secret
  peginSigsPostedAt
  appVaultKeepersVersion
  universalChallengersVersion
  offchainParamsVersion
  currentOwner
  referralCode
  depositorPayoutBtcAddress
  depositorWotsPkHash
  btcPopSignature
  pendingAt
  verifiedAt
  activatedAt
  expiredAt
  expirationReason
  blockNumber
  transactionHash

      }
      pageInfo {
        hasNextPage
        endCursor
      }
    }
  }
","variables":{"depositor":"0x67158c9891fb47e0ca719263392f4657b1c75002","limit":1000},"operationName":"GetVaultsByDepositorFirstPage"}
